config.error404.title: ERROR 404 - settings
config.error404.hint: changes are written to config/error404.json immediately
config.error404.realBlockDeletion.toolti: Off turns the mod into a render-only horror mod: chunks look deleted, nothing is actually removed. /error404 restore is still available, but there is nothing to restore.
config.error404.chaos.tooltip: The "anything can happen" layer: a chunk collapsing in front of you, your own chunk going, sudden death, doors opening, something behind you. Off makes the mod a slow deletion simulator.
config.error404.photosensitivity.tooltip: Removes full-screen static bursts, the HUD glitch layer and the title-screen flicker. Everything else stays.
config.error404.backupOnStart.tooltip: Zips the region folder before a session touches anything. Costs a few seconds on world load.
config.error404.destructiveEnding.toolti: The DELETE ending renames the world folder to world_DELETED_<time> instead of merely ending the session. The world is never erased.
config.error404.protectBlockEntities.too: Block entities (chests, furnaces, spawners, beds) are never deleted by chunk collapse. Off is crueller and loses items.
config.error404.hud.tooltip: A permanent integrity readout in the corner. Off by default: horror needs a clean screen.
config.error404.announceOnJoin.tooltip: Tells players in chat that ERROR 404 is running. Off by default - on a horror server nobody is supposed to be told.
